The '''Spawn Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]], approximately a thirty minute hyper-jump away from [[Betha II]].

==History==
The [[Slayers Three]], a trio of [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] living during the [[Galactic War]], originated the Spawn Nebula.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|The Slayers Three}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] maintained a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the Spawn Nebula, for use in battle against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Dissension forces also constructed a space station to keep its vessels in constant readiness. A member of the Dissension, [[Meres Ulcane]], was discovered on Betha II by New Republic agents, and fled to the Spawn Nebula. The New Republic tracked him, and engaged the Kaarenth Dissension. The resulting [[Mission to the Spawn Nebula|operation]] saw the destruction of the repair station and much of the Dissension fleet.<ref name="Counterstrike" />
